title: nidema ottonis var. triandrum
intro: Nidema ottonis var. triandrum, commonly known as "black pepper vine", is a plant species that belongs to the family Apocynaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, aiding in the treatment of various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
